items.title: Peter Appleyard interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 4, 2012
items.q: Anyway, they put me in front of George and George said, “Can you do this?”

ctx.x: But I hadn’t seen him in all those years. Anyway, they put me in front of George and George said, “Can you do this?” And he went [scats frenetically]. I said, “No I can’t do that.” And Emil said, “That’s too bad you can’t do that because he won’t hire a guy if he can’t do that.
